chapter: Musicians of the era: players, drummers, bassists, pianists
title: Louis Bellson and Dave Black in Ellington's band
summary: Bellson wrote drum parts from the horn parts; after him Duke wanted two bass drums, so Dave Black came in.

story.theme_name: Drummers and drumming: who played what, and how
story.community_name: Great drummers: who they admired and why

blocks.x: So come the next drummer in his place, Louis Bellson. Louis Bellson was an arranger, so Louis Bellson arrangements, especially the suites, Louis Bellson would take a first trumpet part, a first trombone part, first saxophone part, and take it home with him and make a drum part.
And who followed Louis Bellson in there?

A little kid called Dave Black. He -- Louis Bellson used to do clinics in Philadelphia at a drum school and he heard Dave and Dave played two bass drums. You know, Duke didn't want you in there after Louis unless you played two bass drums, because to him Louis Bellson --
